chip.description: NES picture processing unit: a scrolling background tile layer, 64 sprites, the palette and NTSC raster timing on one die (taxonomy §4.20 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/video/ppu2c0x.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Nintendo 2C0x PPU emulation"), device full name "2C02 PPU". The repo already carries the RGB-output 2C03B relative used by PlayChoice-10.
